scope: First 23 statements, through shell interception before hasDamage. Complete hit/death/delivery and underlying guard, shell, spatial, attack-target, victim-condition and presentation operations remain separate.
observations: Invoke original complete resolveHit; record queries, RNG, packet/guard hooks, delayed queue identity, source removal, cues, final state and committed errors. No source instrumentation or implementation replacement in normal captures.
hostBoundary: Host-owned pending fuse queue; execution and cancellation are separate
expectedSemantics: Incoming definition is captured before target-specific instance replacement; later modifiers and damage use the replacement.
Fuse admission occurs before combat, guise, target rewrite and damage. Queue objects borrow skill/flat/effect records and copy origin. Explicit tier zero survives.
Shatter visits live statuses in reverse order and commits removal before source cleanup; failures retain prior writes.
Tone is captured after scaling and before affliction forgo; guard raw uses the post-forgo packet.
Guard runs before shell and either may end the whole hit. Zero raw skips both. Shell overflow mutates the same packet.
Nested calls have separate locals. No rollback or shared scratch substitution is implied.
